scope: Code and targeted regression review only; no browser timing, native raster parity, deployment or release clearance.

guardReview.placement: Inside retainGround after existing pointer/animation/unavailable checks, before eligible offscreen snapshot allocation/copy.
guardReview.onScreenPainter: Unchanged: all ground detail/relief batches, selected area/boundaries, routes, mask and labels execute as before.
guardReview.sourceScheduling: Unchanged: generation creation, tile request ordering, pool concurrency, pins, deadlines, partial-pair publication and canonical commit are untouched.
guardReview.cacheIdentity: groundSignature still includes loadingGround identity; an old retained snapshot cannot restore a different partial cohort. Existing snapshot stays bounded and is released by existing resize/budget/destroy paths.
guardReview.partialFailure: The guard requires both loading=true and a partial cohort. Once loading ends with a failed neighbor, the useful partial view may be retained on its next actual redraw.
guardReview.lateSoleRejection: No new paint/RAF/timer is added merely to capture a cache after a late rejection; the regression waits for a subsequent real redraw.
guardReview.gestureTransformGuards: Active pointer, animation, unavailable snapshot, bearing/pitch and backing-byte limits are retained unchanged.
guardReview.labelCohort: Unchanged complete loading cohort and loadingRelief cache discriminator; no deduplication or stable-sort/collision-order change.

meaningfulRegression.name: progressive loading paints each ready pair without copying every transient full canvas
meaningfulRegression.redFailure: Actual backing copies3 versus expected2 while a real prepared pair still paints.
cases: Three successive vector+relief completions paint immediately while canonical batches remain unchanged.
Active partial frames add no full backing-store copy.
Complete accepted ground is captured and then reused.
Failed neighbor with other arrivals preserves useful staged ground and allows capture after loading ends.
Late sole rejection adds no eager repaint; next actual redraw lazily captures stable partial ground.
No extra source requests or idle RAF are introduced.
meaningfulRegression.lintAndTypes: Root preflight records PASS; their saved log bytes/hashes were independently checked. This review did not rerun them.

tradeoff: An overlay/filter redraw during active loading with an unchanged partial cohort replays the ground painter instead of reusing a newly captured partial snapshot. Pixel intent is unchanged, but this moves work from streaming copies to such redraws; final browser gates remain necessary.
deferredOptimization: Do not remove cached pairs from loadingGround: that changes retained/staged label insertion order and can change collision winners. Any future paint-only deduplication must preserve metadata/labels and compare both actual tile/bitmap identities, not keys alone, with same-z overlapping-pan and same-key-new-bitmap tests. No such production change is included.
remainingEvidence: Baseline trace for actual temporal/CPU attribution; no claim that this code caused the failed p95 window yet.
Exact candidate real loading pixel gate and all original browser/performance gates.
Original six coastline frames per required profile, full accepted CI payload and public verification.
